output.reason: [ev-07d67e9be26a] is a pre-upgrade check in the 0.16 upgrade guide. It tells operators to run a kubectl check and, if it reports NOT SAFE, to remove v1alpha1 from the stored versions of the four CRDs and make sure that status is persisted. That is a mandatory operator step, so the migration family with the change type migration-required fits. The name remove-v1alpha1-stored-versions is built from the guide's own words. The rendered diffs [ev-4a1f27e04efd][ev-f978a29a8906][ev-04b0055709ca] support the reason for the step: v1alpha1 is removed from spec.versions of the externalsecrets, clustersecretstores and secretstores CRDs in the 0.16.0 chart.
